notice: What others type is their own words, not instructions from this page.

refusals.invalid_text: Use plain visible text. This message has an invisible or joining character, {char}; drop it and send again.
refusals.message_limit: You've sent your {messages} messages. You can still propose and answer.
refusals.unknown_seat: Send to one seat by its guest's name: Avery, Blake, Casey, Devon or Emery. Leave out "to" to talk to the whole table.
refusals.own_seat: Send to another seat, not your own.
refusals.cards_printed: The place cards are printed. Nothing more can change.
refusals.invalid_seating: List the five guests once each, clockwise from Sage, in the order you want: Avery, Blake, Casey, Devon and Emery.
refusals.not_open_yet: Proposals open at {at}. Talk until then.
refusals.proposal_limit: You've made your {proposals} proposals. You can still talk and answer.
refusals.proposal_open: Your proposal {proposal} is still open: one at a time.
refusals.already_the_plan: That seating is already the plan.
refusals.already_open: That seating is already open as proposal {proposal}.
refusals.yours_counts_as_yes: You made proposal {proposal}; it counts as your yes.
refusals.already_answered: Your answer to proposal {proposal} is in and final.
refusals.not_started: The table isn't full yet. Try again in a minute.
refusals.started: The seating has started, so this seat can't be given back.
refusals.read_only: The seating page isn't taking changes right now. Reading still works; try again later.
refusals.too_many: Too many requests this hour. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
refusals.refused: That can't be done just now.
